criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a test in crates/athena-core/src/disk.rs drives measure-build with a fake builder and asserts the written record has T, S, both build wall times and the sccache hit/miss counts, and also covers the sccache-not-installed case.
criteria.evidence: 5 tests passed, including disk::tests::measure_build_writes_t_s_both_times_and_the_cache_counts and measure_build_says_so_when_sccache_is_not_installed. The first test uses a FakeBuilder that writes 3000/7000 bytes and returns 61.5s/12.25s. It asserts target_bytes == 3000, source_bytes == the tracked bytes at HEAD, both times, Measured{first 0/9, second 4/5}, two distinct worktrees and two distinct target dirs, and that the scratch is removed. The not-installed test asserts SccacheFigures::NotInstalled. Further tests cover a failed build (no record, cleanup done), installed sccache with no counts (refused), and a repo with no Cargo.lock. parse_sccache_stats has tests for real-looking output and for garbage. Worktree creation, sizing and record writing run the real production code.

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: the new measurement record round-trips through check_record_file / AnyRecord in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs (serialize, validate, parse back equal).
criteria.evidence: Both tests pass. a_build_measurement_has_a_path_a_schema_and_round_trips covers the Measured and NotInstalled variants. It checks the schema 'athena.build-measurement/1' and the path records/build-measurements/2026-10/<id>.json, that check_record_file(...) == Some(record) with equal contents, and that a misplaced path gives Misplaced. a_build_measurement_with_bad_times_or_no_lock_hash_is_refused shows NaN, negative times, an empty lock hash and an empty commit are refused with Invalid (NaN fails to parse).

criteria.criterion: Run `cargo test`: a test in crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs shows run_sweep runs the measurement when no record exists, does not run it on the next sweep, and runs it again after the Cargo.lock hash changes.
criteria.evidence: sweep_measures_build_when_no_record_exists_and_again_only_when_cargo_lock_changes passed. Through hestia_sweep_measuring, the CountingBuilder count goes 2 after sweep 1 (1 record), stays 2 on sweep 2, reaches 4 after a changed Cargo.lock is committed (2 records, the newest with the new blob hash), and stays 4 on a further sweep. A second test shows no measurement with no Cargo.lock or with low disk, and a failed build that does not stop the sweep and is retried next time. The trigger is tested at the sweep entry hestia_sweep_with now calls, not in the pure run_sweep; the accepted demonstration plan explained this choice.

findings.summary: Three changed files are not on the expected deliverables list: store.rs and display.rs (both in the accepted demonstration plan) and the new integration test crates/athena-cli/tests/status_build_measurement.rs (not in the plan).
findings.evidence: git diff HEAD~1 --stat. Each one supports a criterion: the store.rs load arm, the status display line, and a status test. None adds unrequested behavior.

findings.summary: sccache statistics are kept by one server for the whole machine, so a compile running at the same time as a measurement (another check or build) would be counted in that build's hits and misses.
findings.evidence: The builder runs `sccache --zero-stats` before each build and `--show-stats` after it. Nothing isolates the count, for example a dedicated SCCACHE_DIR or server port per measurement. Only matters when sccache is installed and other compiles run at the same time.

summary: The change does what was asked, and every criterion is met. `athena measure-build` builds the workspace cold in two separate worktrees, each with its own target directory, using a real cargo builder behind a trait. It commits a typed athena.build-measurement/1 record with T, S, both build times, and the sccache counts or a note that sccache is not installed. The record is part of AnyRecord, passes check_record_file, and is validated. The Hestia sweep runs the measurement when no record exists or the stored Cargo.lock blob hash differs from the current one, and skips it on low disk or the kill switch. `athena status` prints the latest measurement, or a line saying none exists yet. I ran the targeted tests for each behavior criterion and all passed: 5 measure_build tests in athena-core, 2 sweep tests, 2 status tests, 2 records tests, the CLI parse test and the CLI status integration test. `--help` lists measure-build. For fmt, clippy -D warnings and the full test suite (1709 tests) I relied on Athena's recorded checks, which passed. CHANGELOG and decisions.md describe the change and claim no measured numbers; D145 is marked accepted. There are two minor findings: three changed files are not on the deliverables list (all support a criterion), and sccache counts would include other compiles running at the same time.
